scope: Exact five-source syntax-only frontend controller. No typechecking, component/native qualification or resource-policy change to frozen controllers.

preservedUnrunFindings.finding: Predecessor terminate() could omit escalation when the leader had exited but group descendants survived.
preservedUnrunFindings.correction: waitid(WNOWAIT) retains the direct leader while current group members are censused; TERM then KILL escalation handles remaining members regardless of leader exit. Reap occurs after drain; later checks cannot send a destructive signal after reap.

preservedUnrunFindings.finding: Predecessor had no TERM/INT route into owned cleanup.
preservedUnrunFindings.correction: Flag-only handlers are installed before child creation. Signals are masked around Popen and ownership publication, restored in the parent and reset/unblocked in the child. Cancellation enters the finite cleanup path and prevents PASS.

preservedUnrunFindings.finding: Predecessor hash_fd was neither exact-size bounded nor deadline checked, including the final frontend reread.
preservedUnrunFindings.correction: Every hash has an exact expected length plus one-byte overrun detection and explicit main/final deadline checks; frontend descriptor and named identity remain joined before/final.

preservedUnrunFindings.finding: Predecessor diagnostic budget reset per child and overshot by full chunks.
preservedUnrunFindings.correction: One retained-diagnostic counter spans all five children; each read is bounded by remaining allowance plus one, only the allowance is retained, and overflow is marked incomplete and fails.

checks: All commands use a fixed direct frontend path and -parse, Swift language mode 5, /dev/null module cache, and one sealed anonymous source FD path; no shell or caller-controlled arguments.
Anonymous inputs are written before child FSIZE=0 and sealed against writes/growth/shrink/seal removal; their bytes are independently rehashed afterward.
Only the source memfd is explicitly inherited. Child input is /dev/null, output/error are owned pipes, and TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP/Swift and Clang module-cache environment locations are /dev/null.

Before/final execution requires the exact declared frontend 208647456-byte SHA256 d98470fed50d4efc0075bcbd45ba1f908382dc9222c2b8213d1ff074efaa2083, physical path, 0755 mode, nlink1 and stable descriptor/named identity. Reviewer did not read that host executable.
Current source metadata helpers perform bounded process-identity reads without retaining process names or command lines; only the newly owned parse group is signaled.
Failures retain command state, captured diagnostics and cleanup errors. Forced cleanup, nonzero exit, unresolved absence, cancellation or final hash/deadline failure cannot become PASS.
Selector/pipe/source-FD cleanup stays inside each owned attempt; only one child is active at a time.
limitations: Source review did not execute Python, Swift parsing, compiler, tests, native code or an Oracle command.
Parent filesystem-size limits do not prevent all metadata operations; no global filesystem-write audit is claimed. Diagnostic raw-byte bounds do not include JSON framing/escaping overhead.
This is not full toolchain/dependency admission, import resolution, typechecking, object/module emission, linking, conditional-branch semantic validation, SwiftUI/App acceptance or ABI qualification.
This standalone operation does not lower or execute any existing component/native controller gate and does not release the E Go cache.
Root separately reported one successful actual run after this source clearance. Its raw receipt and host metadata are separate evidence; this source peer does not independently certify that receipt.
